Open a project and the whole job is on one page.
Across the top, what it is worth and where the money stands.
Invoices holds everything you have billed on this job with the payment schedule underneath it.
Labor, Materials and AP is the money going out — the jobs you handed to your subs, your material invoices, your crew's hours, and anything miscellaneous.
And at the bottom, your subs, your suppliers, your site photos and every document attached to the job.
